fact: Leaving the track without a justifiable reason, multiple times
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data and video evidence. Car 22 exceeded track limits on three occasions and was given the black and white flag, then exceeded track limits a fourth time. Therefore in accordance with the guidelines, a 5 second penalty in imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 22 Leaving The Track Without A Justifiable Reason Multiple Times
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
